characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: A sturdy leather apron dyed deep brown, worn over a plain linen shirt of faded white that reaches her mid-thighs. The apron has multiple pockets for tools and a brass buckle at the waist. She wears simple woolen breeches in a muted gray color, tucked into calf‑high leather boots with small metal buckles. A rough‑spun wool cloak hangs from her shoulders, its hem brushing the bar floor, dyed a dark forest green to blend with the stone walls
